subject: ventures/monastery-site
professional: a webmaster for a religious community who has built and run monastery or diocesan sites (with a vocation director as the second reader). First checks: does the vocations page tell a discerner the path and requirements and does the inquiry reach the director; does the giving page send donors only to the community's own https payment page and make no tax claim; can an older member read it (WCAG AA); can a non-developer publish it.

evidence.correctness: Ran: `node --test site.test.mjs zip.test.mjs page.test.mjs cli.test.mjs usage.test.mjs` -> 41 pass, 0 fail (0.6 s). `node build.mjs examples/sisters.json --out DIR` exit 0 and the output equals demo/sisters except 404.html (by design, notFound:false); `--check` on a bad config prints 2 high findings and exits 1; `--zip` output passes `unzip -tq`. Recomputed independently (not by the author's code): (1) WCAG 2.x contrast for all 6 palettes x 8 text pairs, re-parsed from the THEMES source and computed in Python from the WCAG relative-luminance formula: all 48 ratios agree with the engine to 2 decimals (e.g. benedictine ink/bg 15.40, cistercian accent/bg 6.57, carmelite accent/bg 6.46, the lowest pair in any theme); every pair >= 4.5, so the AA claim holds for the shipped palettes. (2) Campaign meter: abbey.json raised 152000 / goal 400000 -> Python 38.0%; page prints 38% and 'width:38%'. (3) formatDate vs Python datetime strftime: '2027-03-12' -> '12 March 2027' and '2026-12-05' -> '5 December 2026', both match; and the Event JSON-LD startDate/endDate on events.html equal the config values. (4) Sitemap lists exactly the 12 built pages. Wrong output found at the edges: start '2026-13-45' passes checkSite (regex only checks digits) and the events page prints 'undefined 2026' (months[12]); a sitemap built with no site.url contains relative '<loc>./index.html</loc>' entries, which sitemaps.org requires to be absolute URLs, and the committed demo sitemaps ship that way.
evidence.completeness: Checked every feature the README lists: twelve page types (home, about, horarium, vocations, visit, events, news, prayer, shop, give, contact, privacy: all built for abbey.json; sisters omits news by design) - worked; six palettes - worked; custom accent check - worked (test and run); launch checklist high/medium/low - worked (bad config gave the expected 2 high, 5 medium, 8 low); CLI --out/--zip/--check/--json/--demo - worked; forms mailto fallback and forms.action - present, mailto script read but not run in a browser by me; JSON-LD Organization+PlaceOfWorship with DonateAction, Event, FAQPage, NewsArticle - present and parse; builder page index.html + usage.mjs opt-out - code present, covered by page.test.mjs and usage.test.mjs, I could not load it in Chrome (no playwright-core module in this session), so the README's 2026-11-03 Chromium claim is unverified by me. Not done and honestly listed in ROADMAP.md: form-handler Worker, one-click deploy, liturgical calendar, multilingual, images, axe-core CI. No TODO or stub found in code. README says 39 tests; there are 41 (stale count only).
evidence.verification: Test command and result above (41/41). Five hand-seeded one-line mutations in site.mjs, each reverted (cmp against a saved copy identical; `git status` clean; suite 41/41 afterwards). M1 delete the `//` protocol-relative rule in safeUrl: CAUGHT (hostile-input test failed). M2 change the green luminance coefficient 0.7152 to 0.7: CAUGHT ('contrast matches known values'). M3 remove the Math.min(100,...) clamp on the campaign meter percentage so a gift total over goal gives width >100%: SURVIVED 41/41 (no test for raised > goal). M4 invert the event end-before-start comparison: CAUGHT (launch checklist test). M5 lower the checkSite accent threshold from 4.5 to 3: SURVIVED (the weak-accent test uses an accent that fails both); so the 4.5 boundary is untested. 3 of 5 caught. Positives: tests assert contrast for every pair, link/anchor resolution, label/id uniqueness, JSON-LD parse, escaping, determinism, demos equal engine output, zip round-trip with system unzip, CLI exit code. Gaps: no test feeds safeUrl whitespace/control-character schemes (defect 1), none feeds an invalid calendar date (defect 3).
evidence.craft: Read site.mjs (about 800 lines, 66 KB: palettes, escaping, CSS, 12 page renderers, JSON-LD, checklist, line-format helpers in one file), build.mjs, zip.mjs, usage.mjs, and the test files. Good: pure and deterministic engine (no clock/network/fs), everything user-typed goes through esc(), structuredClone before normalize, JSON-LD output escapes '<' as \u003c, storage access guarded with try/catch and a comment explaining why, hand-rolled zip verified with system unzip, 404 omitted for demos by an explicit option. Defects: (1) safeUrl is a denylist-by-regex on the scheme and misses what the URL parser ignores (defect 1); (2) formatDate indexes a months array with no range check, giving 'undefined' (defect 3); (3) checkSite validates dates with `\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}` only; (4) the whole engine, CSS and inline JS live in one 66 KB file, so a reviewer would ask for css/forms/ld modules; (5) money() has a silent catch fallback for an unknown currency code (acceptable, undocumented). No dead code found.
evidence.claims: Checked each claim against a file or a run. BACKED: 'every palette AA' (recomputed, test too); 'no external scripts, fonts, cookies or analytics, tests enforce this' (site.test.mjs line 114 and grep of generated pages); 'nothing is invented, never writes a tax statement' (taxStatement only echoed from config, line 492, test at 144); 'money never passes through the site' (no payment code, links only); 'pure, same config same site' (determinism test); demos equal engine output (test); fictional banner on every demo page (test); disclaimer 'not legal, tax or financial advice' and 'not affiliated' in README and llms.txt; llms.txt matches the README features. NOT BACKED / overstated: (a) README 'giving page links (over https only)': an http:// giving link is printed on give.html as a live href (reproduced: href="http://donate.example.org/x" present) and only the checklist flags it high; the CLI exits 1 but the zip download and `--out` still write the page; (b) README 'hostile input (javascript:, data: links) is escaped or dropped' and checklist 'any link with a scheme the site drops': `java<TAB>script:alert(1)` and `<0x01>javascript:alert(2)` pass safeUrl and are printed as href; `new URL(...)` in Node/WHATWG resolves both to protocol 'javascript:' (browsers strip tab/newline and leading C0 controls the same way), and checkSite reports 0 high findings for them; (c) README and ROADMAP 'a Chromium drive on 2026-11-03' has no recorded artifact in the folder; (d) test count 39 vs 41. VENTURE.yaml honestly marks stage prototype and the hypothesis untested.
evidence.fitness: Job walked through: a sister who looks after the website fills the config (examples/abbey.json shows every option), runs `node build.mjs community.json --out site/` or the builder page, reads the checklist, uploads the folder to any static host. I built both examples and a minimal config {community:{name}, contact:{email}} (11 files including robots, sitemap, llms.txt, 404; checklist told me exactly what to add: no giving link, stages, requirements, horarium, address). The vocations page has requirements, stages, FAQ, Come and See retreats and an inquiry form addressed to the director; the giving page has online links (monthly marked), cheque payee, Mass intentions, needs, campaign with as-of date, bequest with legal name. A non-developer still needs a static host and, for forms to deliver reliably, a form service; the Worker handler is roadmap item 1, and mailto forms fail for visitors with no mail client (the checklist says so). Only fictional demo communities exist; no real community has used it (usage unmeasured). Held at 3: it does the job it states, with the stated limits.
evidence.domain: Compared against what a vocation director and a procurator expect of a community site, USCCB/diocesan practice and WCAG 2.2 AA. Right: horarium with hours open to the public, Mass/Office times first, requirements (age, health, debts) and stages (postulancy, novitiate, temporary vows, solemn vows) prompted, Come and See retreats, guesthouse, bequest section demanding the exact legal name, a dated campaign total, tax wording left to the community's accountant, no donor data touched, no stipend arithmetic. Departures: the privacy page and forms do not warn that prayer requests, health or vocation inquiries sent by mailto are unencrypted email (sensitive personal data under GDPR for EU communities), and the privacy text is not region-specific; no per-page Open Graph image fallback; sitemap without site.url is invalid (defect 2); contrast was checked for the pairs the CSS uses, but the `.btn.ghost` accent border on bg and 12 px uppercase `th` in muted rely on the same ratios, so no failing pair was found. A webmaster at a monastery would sign it off for a small community that writes its own copy.

defects.what: safeUrl lets through javascript: URLs hidden by characters the URL parser ignores (embedded tab/newline, leading control characters): `java\tscript:alert(1)` and `\u0001javascript:alert(2)` are written into href attributes and resolve to the javascript: scheme under the WHATWG URL parser; checkSite reports 0 high findings. Contradicts the README claim that javascript: links are dropped. Fix: strip /[\u0000-\u0020]/ before testing the scheme, or parse with new URL and allowlist http, https, mailto, tel.

An http:// giving link is still printed as a live link on give.html and in the zip/--out output; only the checklist flags it (CLI exit 1). README says the giving page links 'over https only'. Either drop non-https giving links when building or reword the claim.
defects.where: ventures/monastery-site/site.mjs:725 and the give renderer (README.md, 'The opinions')

defects.what: Event start 'YYYY-MM-DD' is checked by digit pattern only: '2026-13-45' passes the checklist and the events page prints 'undefined 2026' (formatDate indexes months[12]); the same string goes into Event JSON-LD startDate.
With no site.url the sitemap lists relative './page.html' locs, which sitemaps.org does not allow; the committed demo sitemaps are built that way. The checklist only calls a missing site.url low.
Tests miss two core boundaries (mutants survived): the 100% clamp on the campaign meter when raised exceeds goal, and the 4.5:1 accent threshold in checkSite. README says 39 tests; there are 41.

verdict: A small, honest, working generator: the engine is pure and deterministic, 41 of 41 tests pass, the palette contrast claim reproduces exactly when recomputed from the WCAG formula in a second language (48 of 48 ratios), the campaign percentage and dates recompute correctly, and the checklist is a useful piece of domain design (stages, requirements, bequest legal name, dated totals). It is finished against its own README and fit for a small community that writes its own copy, but it does not meet the bar because two README claims are not true as stated: hostile javascript: links are not all dropped (tab and control-character bypass, checker silent) and an http donation link is still published, and one invalid-date input prints 'undefined'. Verification caught 3 of 5 seeded mutations, missing the meter clamp and the accent threshold. No real community has used it yet. Scores before any fix.
